## Description

Estimates non-parametric self-exciting Hawkes kernels on buy/sed order cancel-trade arrival streams to calculate real-time trade toxicity scores and dynamically halt market making during adverse selection.

## Where it may fit

Flash crashes, toxic order flow surges, high-frequency market making inventory protection.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Crypto Prop Desks, Algorithmic Execution Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book event logs with microsecond timestamps.

## Caveats

Non-parametric kernel estimation requires sliding window updates to prevent parameter staleness.

- <https://github.com/hawkeslib/hawkeslib>
- <https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.09876>
